e019-p2: validate 'O' state abbreviation and list cities → search-cities (A347). 'O' is not valid but the skill serves the request. Positive A347. Maybe A291? No, cities is A347.

e034-p1: fill missing intermediate yearly figure from 2020/2024 totals with constant growth → data-reconciliation (A221, CAGR). Positive A221.

e099-p1: search flights → A372 search-flights. Positive.

e079-p1: visual diagram of conversation branching from transcript → dialogue-graph (A383). Positive A383. Maybe d3-visualization too? Dialogue-graph covers visualizing. A383 primary.

e064-p2: list commit history of tailwindcss default branch → A062 list_commits. Positive.

e093-p2: quadrotor attitude PID tuning + desired acceleration to attitude → attitude-controller-planner (A239), imc-tuning-rules? PID gains: imc-tuning-rules for first-order systems. The conversion accel→attitude is A239. Acceptable: A239. IMC tuning rules maybe. Accept A239 only (or +A302?). IMC tuning rules for first-order systems — attitude loop tuning, plausible but A239 covers planning+control. I'll include A239, A302.

e038-c3: ArkTS object literal static semantics → arkts-sta-spec (A154). Positive A154.

e082-c3: recreate venv with uv → A332 uv-package-manager. Positive.

e069-p1: custom ArkUI component with dialog/animation, ArkTS syntax restrictions → A147 (hmos-arkui-develop-skill), A152 harmony-router? A162 knowledge-retriever? Component dev with ArkTS syntax. A147 seems best. Also A152. Acceptable: A147, A152.

h082-prompt: rawheap conversion, cluster, two-version comparison → hmos-jsleak-analysis (A184). Positive.

h099-prompt: MPC horizon and Q/R tuning for web handling → mpc-horizon-tuning (A304). Positive.

e097-c1: count cars in photo → object-counter (A279). Positive. Maybe openai-vision too (A324). Acceptable A279, A324.

e023-c1: integer programming scheduling, select installed solver, output status/objective → mip-solver-and-solution-audit (A249). Also milp-solver-workflow (A328). Scheduling with min rest days — could be ordered-window-sequencing-mip? Shift scheduling, not sequencing. A249 mentions "selecting an installed solver, preserving solver/incumbent certificates". Accept A249, A328.

e018-c2: Boot 3 JAXB deprecated deps → spring-boot-migration (A223). Positive.

e040-c1: search issue about memory usage with parquet → search_issues (A102). Positive.

e065-c2: manual picking vs deep learning pickers pros/cons → seismic-picker-selection (A266). Positive.

e020-p2: rewrite order query to WebFlux reactive → senior-java (A229)? Spring Boot reactive... A229 covers Spring Boot. Positive A229.

e068-c2: log4j security advisory details → list_global_security_advisories (A067) / search? "查一下它对应的security advisory编号和详情" — find advisory for a dependency version. A067 list global security advisories, A040 get advisory. Acceptable A067, A040. Hmm, but no search advisories by package. A067 is closest. Positive with A067, A040.

h015-prompt: HarmonyOS search nearby coffee shops, geocoding, local SDK ArkTS code → hmos-map-kit-poi-search (A204). Positive.

e028-c3: add three sub-issues to #90 → sub_issue_write (A109) or add_sub_issue (A011). Acceptable A011, A109.

h033-prompt: rotation, foldable, G state → hmos-multidevice-natural-orientation (A176). Positive.

e047-c3: dynamic object masks after global motion compensation, CSR format → dyn-object-masks (A270). Positive.

e029-c1: restaurants in Chengdu → search-restaurants (A314). Positive.

e010-c1: create project board + add issues → projects_write (A087). Positive.

e088-p1: tolerances when validating solution, tiny violations → mip-solver-and-solution-audit (A249)? That's about audit/certificates. Also scip-opt? "how should I set tolerances when validating the solution" — A249 (solution audit). Acceptable A249. Maybe output-validation (A374) is about masks. I'll take A249.

h096-prompt: ADA bathroom plan-view check → ada-plan-view-accessibility (A398). Positive.

h040-prompt: fix arkts static compile errors → A151 arkts-static-compile-error-repair, A149 (compile/fix errors). A151 exactly. Acceptable A151, A149.

e005-p1: V1/V2 decorators mixed in ArkUI → hmos-arkui-statemgt-migration (A148). Positive.
